source_dependency_failure_rule: SOURCE_DEPENDENCY_FAIL is permitted only when readable machine-readable source dependency assessment evidence positively establishes CANTERA_REQUIRED=true. Parser, tooling, or undifferentiated dependency-preflight process failure is OTHER_TOOLING_FAIL.
source_nonconvergence_rule: SOURCE_NONCONVERGED is permitted only for a point that actually executed native AGTF30/T-MATS, produced native out_SS, and has explicit out_SS.converged evidence indicating nonconvergence.
matlab_action_failure_rule: Licensing, MATLAB startup, action runtime, and undifferentiated step failure are tooling/action failures. If available metadata does not prove timeout or a more specific source/build class, use MATLAB_ACTION_EXECUTION_FAIL.
timeout_rule: NATIVE_STEP_TIMEOUT_TOOLING_FAIL is permitted only when GitHub/action metadata explicitly establishes a timeout. A generic failed run-command outcome is not sufficient to fabricate timeout certainty.
note: A semantic-deck candidate pass is not final P1 semantic-deck acceptance. Downstream Oversight must review the controlled artifact before semantic P1 authority is accepted.
semantic_parser_failure_rule: SEMANTIC_PARSER_FAIL is carried by Semantic_Status after a converged native point fails reviewed semantic extraction. The same point retains Run_Status=PASS_NATIVE_CONVERGED and Native_Converged=1; raw MAT remains authoritative.
semantic_warning_review_rule: SEMANTIC_WARNING_REVIEW_FAIL is used when current-run machine-readable diary review finds an uncontextualized reviewed warning occurrence, the warning at an unexpected point, or warning-count growth beyond the reviewed Run #3 baseline. Zero warning occurrences are permitted.
semantic_point_status_rule: Semantic_Status uses SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION_PASS_CANDIDATE, SEMANTIC_PARSER_FAIL, NOT_EXECUTED_BY_GRID_POLICY, or an explicit NOT_EVALUATED_* reason. Semantic success remains candidate-only.
native_semantic_status_separation_rule: native_reference_execution_summary.csv preserves native execution status. semantic_reference_execution_summary.csv carries semantic extraction status. Semantic failure must not overwrite a valid native PASS status.
